An equation is a balance

equationtwo sides that are equal, like a level balance
variablea letter (x) for the mystery number
solvefind the number that makes it true
checkput your number back in and test it
The balance ruleWhatever you do to one side, do the same to the other side. Then it stays level.

Two steps: last step first

Two steps: undo in reverse order.Shoes go on after socks, so shoes come off first. In 3x + 5, x was × 3 first, then + 5. So undo + 5 first, then × 3.

Trap! 5 less than n is n − 5, not 5 − n. Start with the number, then take 5 away.

Stickers

Mia has some stickers. Her friend gives her 14 more. Now she has 50 stickers. How many stickers did Mia have at first?

The whole bar is 50. One part is 14. The other part is what Mia had at first.
1Let
s = the number of stickers Mia had at first
2Equation
3Solve
s = 50 − 14 =
4Check
+ 14 = 50 ✓
Answer stickers

Word problems

Numbers in a row

Three numbers in a row (like 5, 6, 7) add up to 75. What is the smallest number?

Hint: call the smallest number n. The next two are n + 1 and n + 2.

Answer
35

Rectangle

A rectangle is twice as long as it is wide. Its perimeter is 66 cm. How wide is it?

Hint: width = w, length = 2w. Perimeter = all four sides added.

Answer cm
36

Challenge: the book

Ben reads 1/3 of a book on Monday. On Tuesday he reads the rest of the book, which is 120 pages more than he read on Monday. How many pages does the book have?

Hint: Tuesday is 2/3 of the book. Draw the book as a bar cut into 3 equal parts.

Answer pages
